name: AI Optimization Dashboard
author: garasaya

sections.description:
AIO Dashboard helps AI search engines such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity understand your site correctly and cite it. Prepare your site for AI, find out what to improve, and check whether AI visits and cites your site, all from your WordPress dashboard.

What you can do

  • Make your site easy for AI to read — Manage robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt for AI crawlers, and output Schema.org structured data automatically. Files your SEO plugin already manages are not changed unless you choose to.
  • Find out which pages to improve (AIO score) — AI scores each page for E-E-A-T and PREP structure and shows which pages to fix first.
  • Create FAQs for AI search — Generate question-and-answer drafts from your pages, and display them with FAQPage structured data using a shortcode.
  • See visits from AI — Check whether AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot visit your site, alongside Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data.
  • Measure whether AI cites your site (AI citation sampling survey) — Regularly ask AI services about your keywords and record whether your site is cited.
  • Get ideas for your next article (content generation) — Get article topics and drafts based on your site’s analysis.

Generated FAQs and articles are always saved as drafts. Nothing is published until you review it.

Free features and paid options

  • Free, without a license key: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt management, Schema.org structured data, FAQ generation from headings, breadcrumbs, and the AI crawler log.
  • With a license key (free to get): AI-enhanced structured data (including business details such as address and phone number), the AIO score, AI-generated FAQs, and the Google Analytics 4 and Search Console connections.
  • Paid options: AI citation sampling survey and content generation. Prices are shown on the sign-up screen.

Your data

Without a license key, no content leaves your server. Page titles and content are sent to our backend only when you use AI features with a license key. See “External Services” below for exactly what is sent and when.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services. Each one is used only in these cases:

  • Service 1 (AIO Dashboard backend): only when a license key is registered. Post and page content is sent only by the AI features, which run in ai_enhanced mode.
  • Service 2 (AI providers): only through our backend, when the AI features in service 1 are used. The plugin never contacts AI providers directly.
  • Service 3 (geocoding): only when business entity extraction finds a postal address.
  • Service 4 (AI crawler activity sync): whenever a license key is registered, in either mode.
  • Service 5 (access report emails): partner-contracted sites only, and only if you turn it on.
  • Services 6 and 7 (Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console): only if you connect them on the Settings screen. A license key and domain ownership verification are required.
  • Service 8 (IndexNow): only if you turn it on in the Settings screen and a license key is registered. Only page URLs are sent.
  • Service 9 (Google Indexing API): partner-contracted sites only, if you turn it on and a license key is registered. Only job posting page URLs are sent.

1. AIO Dashboard Backend (app.aio-dash.com)

The plugin communicates with the AIO Dashboard backend service for:

  • License verification — Your license key and site domain are sent with every API request to verify your subscription.
  • AI-assisted FAQ generation (POST /api/v1/ai/faq) — When FAQ generation is triggered in ai_enhanced mode, the title and content of the post being processed are sent to our backend, which passes them to an AI provider (see service 2) to generate question-and-answer pairs. When FAQ candidates are selected in bulk, the titles, excerpts, and URLs of candidate posts, plus your site name and tagline, are also sent.
  • AI-enhanced schema generation (POST /api/v1/ai/schema-enhance) — When a post or page is published/updated in ai_enhanced mode, or when bulk generation is triggered, the title and content of the post are sent to our backend, which uses an AI model to determine the page’s structured-data type (e.g. AboutPage, Service, JobPosting, Event) and generate description, abstract, and keywords properties.
  • AIO score analysis (POST /api/v1/ai/page-quality/runs) — When you manually trigger “Analyze site” (Dashboard screen), the title and content of up to 60 pages (full text for up to 40, excerpts for the remainder) are sent to our backend, which uses an AI model to score each page’s citability to AI search engines and suggest improvements. To understand the site as a whole, the titles and short excerpts of up to 150 pages and recent posts, plus your site name and tagline, are sent together.
  • Business entity extraction (POST /api/v1/ai/business-entity/refresh) — When a fixed page (page post type) is published/updated in ai_enhanced mode, or when “Analyze site” is run manually, the title and full text content of all of your site’s published fixed pages (not just the changed one, up to 40 pages) are sent to our backend, which uses an AI model to extract site-wide business facts — business type, address, phone number, service area, external profile links (sameAs), founding date, founder name(s), and license/registration numbers — for use in the Organization/LocalBusiness schema and llms.txt.
  • Content suggestions and generation (POST /api/v1/ai/content-ideation/runs) — When you run content suggestions, the titles and excerpts of your posts and pages are sent so that an AI model can propose new articles. Generated articles are returned as drafts.
  • AI citation sampling survey (/api/v1/sampling/items) — The keywords you register and the AI services you select are stored on our backend, which periodically asks those AI services about the keywords and records whether your site is cited.
  • Tutorial emails (/api/v1/tutorial-mail/settings, self-serve licenses only, opt-in) — If you opt in, our backend stores the email address you enter and sends four how-to emails. Off by default.
  • Menu visibility (PUT /api/v1/menu-visibility, partner licenses only) — The keys of features you hide from non-administrators. No personal data.
  • License status check (GET /api/v1/license/status) — Periodically checks whether your license is active and which mode (structural or ai_enhanced) is enabled.

No personally identifiable information about your site visitors is ever sent.

The submitted data and the results (such as page titles, scores, suggestions, extracted business information, and generated drafts) are stored on our backend for as long as needed to provide the service. See the privacy policy below for retention periods and deletion.

Service privacy policy: https://aio-dash.com/privacy/
Service terms of use: https://aio-dash.com/terms/

2. AI providers: Anthropic (api.anthropic.com) and OpenAI (api.openai.com)

When AI features are used, the AIO Dashboard backend sends the data described in service 1 to an AI provider — Anthropic or OpenAI, depending on the service settings — to generate FAQ pairs, schema properties, business entity facts, AIO scores, and content suggestions. For partner licenses that use their own API key, the provider chosen by the partner is used. This processing occurs server-side on our backend — the plugin itself does not communicate directly with any AI provider.

  • Anthropic Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • Anthropic Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
  • OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • OpenAI Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

3. Geocoding of Space Information Authority of Japan / GSI (msearch.gsi.go.jp)

When business entity extraction (see service 1) extracts a postal address, the AIO Dashboard backend sends only that address text to this public geocoding API, operated by a Japanese government agency, to add latitude/longitude (geo) to the Organization/LocalBusiness schema.

  • Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (国土地理院): https://www.gsi.go.jp/

4. AI Crawler Activity Sync (app.aio-dash.com)

The plugin always detects AI crawler visits (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and others) from your server’s own request log and displays them locally on the AIO Dashboard > Access Analysis screen, regardless of license status. When a license key is active, an aggregated daily summary of this local data — the count of detections per AI service per day — is additionally synced to our backend so it can also inform other features (such as content generation suggestions).

  • Only aggregated counts are sent: service name, date, and hit count. The underlying raw data — user-agent strings, request paths, and IP addresses (which this plugin never records to begin with) — never leaves your server.
  • Without a license key, no sync occurs and AI crawler detection remains entirely local.
  • Sync runs once daily via WP-Cron. On the first sync after activation, up to 90 days of existing local history is sent as a one-time backfill; afterwards only new days are sent.

5. Access report emails (partner licenses only, optional, opt-in)

For sites licensed through a partner, the AIO Dashboard > Access Analysis screen offers “Send reports”. Only when you enable it and enter recipient email addresses, our backend (app.aio-dash.com) periodically creates a PDF report from the data it already holds for your site (AI crawler activity counts, Google Analytics and Search Console summaries if connected, sampling investigation results, AIO score results and the number of FAQs/articles/schema updates created) and emails it to those addresses, with your partner shown as the sender and reply-to address. To write the report’s overview, a summary of these figures (not your page content) is sent to the AI provider described in service 2. The recipient addresses and frequency are stored on our backend; you can stop the reports at any time from the same screen.

6. Google Analytics 4 (optional, opt-in)

If you click “Connect” for Google Analytics on the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen, your browser is redirected to Google’s OAuth consent screen to authorize read-only access to one of your GA4 properties (analytics.readonly scope). Google then redirects back to the AIO Dashboard backend (app.aio-dash.com), which stores the authorization and — not the plugin itself — periodically queries the Google Analytics Data API on your behalf. Retrieved data (session counts, traffic channels, referrer sources, top pages) is cached on our backend for up to 1 hour and displayed on the AIO Dashboard > Access Analysis screen.

  • Only aggregate, read-only reporting data is retrieved. The plugin and backend never write to or modify your Google Analytics account.
  • You can disconnect at any time from the Settings screen, which deletes the stored authorization on our backend.
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google API Services User Data Policy (including the Limited Use requirements we comply with): https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy

7. Google Search Console (optional, opt-in)

If you click “Connect” for Google Search Console on the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen, your browser is redirected to Google’s OAuth consent screen to authorize read-only access to one of your verified Search Console properties (webmasters.readonly scope). Google then redirects back to the AIO Dashboard backend, which stores the authorization and periodically queries the Search Console API on your behalf. Retrieved data (search queries, clicks, impressions, average position, top pages, sitemap submission status) is cached on our backend for up to 1 hour and displayed on the AIO Dashboard > Access Analysis screen. It may also be used to compare search rankings with AI citation results and to inform content suggestions for your site. If you click “インデックス状況を確認する” (Check index status) on the Access Analysis screen, the URLs of up to 60 of your published pages (no content) are sent to our backend, which checks them with the Search Console URL Inspection API and stores the results.

  • Only aggregate, read-only reporting data is retrieved. The plugin and backend never write to or modify your Search Console account.
  • You can disconnect at any time from the Settings screen, which deletes the stored authorization on our backend.
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google API Services User Data Policy (including the Limited Use requirements we comply with): https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy

8. IndexNow (optional, opt-in, api.indexnow.org)

If you enable “IndexNowで更新を通知” (Notify updates via IndexNow) on the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen and a license key is set, the URL of a post or page is sent to the IndexNow API (https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow) when it is published or updated, so that participating search engines (Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and others) can discover the change quickly.

  • Disabled by default, and nothing is sent while no license key is set.
  • Only the published page URL, your site’s host name, and the IndexNow key (a random value generated by the plugin and published at https://your-site/{key}.txt so the engines can verify ownership) are sent. No page content or visitor data is sent.
  • The same URL is sent at most once every 24 hours.
  • IndexNow terms and documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement (Bing operates the IndexNow API endpoint): https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

9. Google Indexing API (optional, opt-in, indexing.googleapis.com, partner-contracted sites only)

For sites contracted through a partner, if you enable “求人ページの公開・更新・削除をGoogleへ知らせる” (Notify Google about job posting pages) in the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen and a license key is set, the URL of a post or page that contains job posting structured data (JobPosting) is sent to our backend (https://app.aio-dash.com) when it is published, updated, unpublished or deleted. The backend forwards the URL to the Google Indexing API (https://indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish) so that Google can reflect the change in job search results sooner. Google permits this API only for pages with job posting or livestream structured data.

  • Disabled by default, and nothing is sent while no license key is set. The setting is shown only for partner-contracted sites.
  • Only the page URL and the notification type (updated or deleted) are sent. No page content or visitor data is sent.
  • The site owner must add our service account as an owner of the site’s property in Google Search Console; otherwise Google rejects the notification.
  • The same URL and type are sent at most once per hour.
  • Google API Services Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Privacy Policy

For information on what data this plugin collects and transmits, please see our full privacy policy: https://aio-dash.com/privacy/

For site owners: If your site uses the AI-enhanced license, you should disclose in your own privacy policy that post content may be transmitted to a third-party AI processing service for the purpose of generating structured data and FAQ content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aio-dash folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to AIO Dashboard > Settings to configure robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt options.
  4. If you have a license key, enter it in AIO Dashboard > Settings > License to enable AI-enhanced features.

Shortcodes

  • [aio_dash_faq] — Display all published FAQ posts (the aio_dash_faq post type)
  • [aio_dash_content id="123"] — Display one published, AI-generated content article by post ID
  • [aio_dash_breadcrumb] — Display a visual breadcrumb navigation with BreadcrumbList schema
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without a license key?

Yes. All structural features (Schema.org output, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, FAQ generation via heading analysis) work without a license key and without any external API calls.

What data is sent externally?

Only when a license key is active and the mode is ai_enhanced: the title and plain-text content of the post/page being processed are sent to our backend (app.aio-dash.com), which passes it to an AI provider (Anthropic or OpenAI). For fixed pages specifically, all of your site’s published fixed pages are additionally sent together so that site-wide business facts (address, phone number, etc.) can be extracted; if an address is found, it is separately sent (address text only) to the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan’s public geocoding API to obtain coordinates. No visitor data, passwords, or personally identifiable information are ever transmitted. Separately, if you choose to connect Google Analytics 4 and/or Google Search Console from the Settings screen (entirely optional; requires a license key), read-only reporting data is retrieved from Google and displayed on the Access Analysis screen — see “External Services” above for details.

Is this plugin compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, or SEOPress?

Yes. If one of these plugins already manages robots.txt or sitemap.xml, the settings screen shows a warning and changes nothing on its own. If you choose to enable the AIO Dashboard feature anyway, only the conflicting feature of the other plugin (for example, its XML sitemap) is turned off. The other plugin stays active, its other features keep working, and any custom robots.txt rules you entered there are kept in its settings.

Which PHP versions are supported?

PHP 5.6.4 through PHP 8.2 and later. The plugin is tested on both ends of this range.

Which WordPress versions are supported?

WordPress 4.9.8 and later. WordPress 3.6.1 and below are not supported.

How does the FAQ shortcode work?

Generate FAQ posts from the AIO Dashboard > FAQ screen (the aio_dash_faq custom post type). Generated posts are saved as drafts. After reviewing and publishing them, insert [aio_dash_faq] into any page — it automatically displays all currently published FAQ posts.

How is the AI-enhanced schema generated?

When a post or page is published or updated (and ai_enhanced mode is active), the plugin automatically sends the title and content to the backend API. The generated description, abstract, and keywords are cached in post meta. If the content has not changed since the last generation, the API is not called again.
sections.changelog:
1.0.69

  • Changed: コンテンツ生成のショートコードを置いた投稿を保存するとき、タイトルが空なら記事のタイトルを自動で入れるようにした。一覧でタイトルが空欄にならない。入力済みのタイトルは変えない。
  • Removed: ショートコードの title=”show” と、「タイトルも表示する」「タイトルをコピー」を削除した。

1.0.68

  • Changed: FAQ の一覧とコンテンツ生成の画面で、ショートコードの欄をクリック (タップ) するとコピーできるようにした。コピーしたことは、短いポップアップで知らせる。
  • Changed: コンテンツ生成の「ショートコードをコピー」のリンクを削除した。

1.0.67

  • Changed: コンテンツ生成の画面で、コピーの操作をボタンから文字のリンクに変えた。「タイトルをコピー」はカードのタイトルの右に、「ショートコードをコピー」と「本文をコピー」は生成結果の中に置いた。

1.0.66

  • Added: コンテンツ生成の生成結果に「公開」ボタンを追加した。編集画面を開かずに記事を公開できる。ボタンを押したときだけ公開される。
  • Added: コンテンツ生成のショートコードに title=”show” を追加した。設置先で、記事のタイトルも見出しとして表示できる。画面の「タイトルも表示する」で切り替え、「タイトルをコピー」で投稿のタイトル欄へ貼り付けられる。
  • Changed: 生成結果から、アイデアのカードと重複していた見出しと要約を外した。

1.0.65

  • Changed: コンテンツ生成で「サイトを解析する」の実行中に、進行状況のバーが縞模様で動き続けるようにした。
  • Changed: コンテンツ生成の画面の「今月のコンテンツ生成」を「今月の下書き生成」に改めた。数えるのは記事の下書きを生成した回数で、「サイトを解析する」は数えない。
  • Changed: ディレクトリに掲載するアイコンとバナー画像を新しくした。

  • Google API Services User Data Policy (including the Limited Use requirements we comply with): https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy

7. Google Search Console (optional, opt-in)

If you click “Connect” for Google Search Console on the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen, your browser is redirected to Google’s OAuth consent screen to authorize read-only access to one of your verified Search Console properties (webmasters.readonly scope). Google then redirects back to the AIO Dashboard backend, which stores the authorization and periodically queries the Search Console API on your behalf. Retrieved data (search queries, clicks, impressions, average position, top pages, sitemap submission status) is cached on our backend for up to 1 hour and displayed on the AIO Dashboard > Access Analysis screen. It may also be used to compare search rankings with AI citation results and to inform content suggestions for your site. If you click “インデックス状況を確認する” (Check index status) on the Access Analysis screen, the URLs of up to 60 of your published pages (no content) are sent to our backend, which checks them with the Search Console URL Inspection API and stores the results.

  • Only aggregate, read-only reporting data is retrieved. The plugin and backend never write to or modify your Search Console account.
  • You can disconnect at any time from the Settings screen, which deletes the stored authorization on our backend.
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google API Services User Data Policy (including the Limited Use requirements we comply with): https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy

8. IndexNow (optional, opt-in, api.indexnow.org)

If you enable “IndexNowで更新を通知” (Notify updates via IndexNow) on the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen and a license key is set, the URL of a post or page is sent to the IndexNow API (https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow) when it is published or updated, so that participating search engines (Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and others) can discover the change quickly.

  • Disabled by default, and nothing is sent while no license key is set.
  • Only the published page URL, your site’s host name, and the IndexNow key (a random value generated by the plugin and published at https://your-site/{key}.txt so the engines can verify ownership) are sent. No page content or visitor data is sent.
  • The same URL is sent at most once every 24 hours.
  • IndexNow terms and documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement (Bing operates the IndexNow API endpoint): https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

9. Google Indexing API (optional, opt-in, indexing.googleapis.com, partner-contracted sites only)

For sites contracted through a partner, if you enable “求人ページの公開・更新・削除をGoogleへ知らせる” (Notify Google about job posting pages) in the AIO Dashboard > Settings screen and a license key is set, the URL of a post or page that contains job posting structured data (JobPosting) is sent to our backend (https://app.aio-dash.com) when it is published, updated, unpublished or deleted. The backend forwards the URL to the Google Indexing API (https://indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish) so that Google can reflect the change in job search results sooner. Google permits this API only for pages with job posting or livestream structured data.

  • Disabled by default, and nothing is sent while no license key is set. The setting is shown only for partner-contracted sites.
  • Only the page URL and the notification type (updated or deleted) are sent. No page content or visitor data is sent.
  • The site owner must add our service account as an owner of the site’s property in Google Search Console; otherwise Google rejects the notification.
  • The same URL and type are sent at most once per hour.
  • Google API Services Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
